title: Optimizer Tools Available
lead: MOC has developed new Foaming Intake tools with a Thumb Actuator Cap to be used with Optimizer™. These tools were created to provide our customers with an optional thumb actuator cap.
body: The MOC Optimizer™ product (Part No. 16501) is sold separately.
See the attached chart showing all the tools available and their part numbers.

figures.caption: Thumb Actuator Cap on Optional Foaming Intake Tools
These new tools are not replacing the existing tools; both versions are available
